snippet.title: Prison Gambit | Official Trailer (Demo)
snippet.description:
You and your fellow inmates have one shot at freedom. The catch? Only one of you walks out and the only way out is through each other.

Prison Gambit is a 4-12 player social party game where every round is a real psychology experiment in disguise. Cut secret face-to-face deals from your cell... then  betray them in front of everyone. It's game night with your friends - if game night could (almost) end a friendship, and you'd laugh about it after.

  🎮 The demo is LIVE now during Steam Next Fest; grab your crew and play:
  👉 Wishlist + Play the Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4427230/Prison_Gambit/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=trailer

  ▶ No teams, only alliances. No traitors, only betrayals.
  ▶ A pool of distinct social minigames; every session feels different
  ▶ Cell + Hall: private planning, public dealmaking
  ▶ Native in-game voice — every deal, every double-cross
  ▶ Built for big groups, not just couples (4–12 players)
  ▶ Playable in 14 languages
  
  #PrisonGambit #SteamNextFest #PartyGame #IndieGame #socialdeduction 

Tags:
prison gambit, party game, social deduction, betrayal game, among us like, multiplayer party game, game theory game, steam next fest, indie game, voice chat game, 4-12 player game, prisoner's dilemma game
